title: Generic query and lifecycle trace APIs
description: Add Core deterministic query/reverse traversal foundations and lifecycle trace helpers across extension and architecture elements.
completion_criteria: Core queries generic elements by registered type and explicit IDs without importing lifecycle.
Lifecycle helpers filter by status/owner and trace forward or reverse with relation filters and maximum depth.
Return deterministic paths without requiring render or DOM creation.
success_criteria: MVP AC-03 passes for Requirement -> Architecture -> Test -> Evidence.
One-to-many, many-to-many, cycles, and depth limits have focused tests.
